pages.title: Golfdash
pages.creator: JazzCat Studio
pages.description: Roll through maze-like courses in Golfdash and find a way to get the ball to the goal. The thirty levels mix golf with compact navigation puzzles, so check which passages connect before you move. Use the arrow keys or WASD to guide the ball through the layout.

pages.title: Archer: Dungeon Hero
pages.creator: GamePush
pages.description: Build an archer for each new run in Archer: Dungeon Hero. Defeat monsters to gain experience, then choose abilities that work together as the waves get tougher. Keep some distance from enemies and move out of the path of their projectiles before finding a safe chance to attack.

pages.title: Dogs vs Aliens
pages.creator: Square Dino LLC
pages.description: Rescue kidnapped pets in Dogs vs Aliens by fighting the creatures that took them. Collect resources to evolve your dogs so they can challenge stronger enemies. Free more breeds as you explore places such as the beach, park and forest, and add the rescued dogs to your growing team.

pages.title: ChickZ Stack
pages.creator: EmotGame
pages.description: Guide a tower of flying chickens through obstacle courses in ChickZ Stack. Gather chickens to make the stack taller and use its extra height to get past walls, traps and enemies. Work through different worlds, unlock more chickens and see how your runs compare with your best score.

pages.title: Mobile Phone Case Design & DIY
pages.creator: Bravestars Games
pages.description: Decorate a phone case in Mobile Phone Case Design & DIY. Choose the look you want and use the design tools to apply colors and artwork to the plain case. Experiment with combinations as you work so the finished case reflects your own style.

pages.title: Animal Swipe
pages.creator: Playgama
pages.description: Find pairs of matching animals in Animal Swipe and clear the pieces required by each level. Check the arrangement before selecting a pair, then look for the new matches it opens up. Use the available power-ups when they can help you finish the board's objective.

pages.title: Fun Mini Games For Kids
pages.creator: Yiv.Com
pages.description: Choose an activity from Fun Mini Games For Kids and work through a short creative or role-playing task. Try a doctor simulation, match shapes to make an avatar, dress a Brainrot character or arrange a room. Switch activities when you want to make something different.

pages.title: Energy Superman 3D
pages.creator: bestgames.com
pages.description: Fly through the city as a superhero in Energy Superman 3D. Pick up energy orbs while steering clear of obstacles on the route. Build your score as you go and use the energy you gather to confront the monstrous threats waiting in the city.

pages.title: Fly Fly Fly
pages.creator: Catom Games
pages.description: Keep a bird airborne through thirty stages in Fly Fly Fly. Avoid the ground and watch for earthworms that cost a life when you hit them. Pick up berries to recover health, and choose your flight path carefully so you can reach the end before losing all your lives.

pages.title: Match 3D Puzzle Saga
pages.creator: Inlogic Software
pages.description: Find matching objects in Match 3D Puzzle Saga to clear each level and earn coins. Choose among three difficulty settings for a board and make use of the special abilities when they suit the arrangement. Complete daily challenges to pick up extra rewards as you keep playing.

pages.title: Hunting underwater spearfishing
pages.creator: dreamgames
pages.description: Explore lakes and open water as a diver in Hunting underwater spearfishing. Look for fish with your harpoon, search for underwater treasure and watch out for predators. Upgrade equipment such as your mask, air tank and harpoon as you take on different waters and encounter more marine species.

pages.title: Sprunky Incredibox Mods
pages.creator: GeekPlay
pages.description: Put together a sound-making group in Sprunky Incredibox Mods. Try characters from ten mods, choose from a large collection of skins and listen to the unique sounds different Sprunki bring to the mix. Change the lineup and setting to hear how another arrangement comes together.

pages.title: Shine Seek
pages.creator: GMG
pages.description: Search glowing scenes for gems and treasure in Shine Seek. Examine the details around each hiding place and solve the logic challenges that stand in your way. Work through the treasure-hunt puzzles one at a time to discover what the next scene contains.

pages.title: Royal Jewels Match
pages.creator: Inlogic Software
pages.description: Match three or more identical gems in Royal Jewels Match and collect coins from completed levels. Use your earnings for decorating between puzzles, and try the special events for additional challenges. Keep track of each level's objective so your matches help you earn crowns and advance.

pages.title: Limited Kaboom
pages.creator: Kool Games
pages.description: Launch your companions at enemy constructions in Limited Kaboom. Drag to choose a trajectory and release to send a shot into the structure. Work out which supports can bring it down while keeping the hero alive, and let the falling pieces take care of the enemies.

pages.title: Slime Rush
pages.creator: Colormind Games
pages.description: Swipe left or right to steer a group of slimes in Slime Rush. Grow the group as you move along the track and avoid obstacles that can cut the run short. Collect gems along the route and put them toward skins and power-ups for later attempts.

pages.title: Dino Simulator City Attack
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Roam a city as a prehistoric dinosaur in Dino Simulator City Attack. Run, jump and smash your way through the streets, choosing among different dinosaur species. Check the objective at the start of each level and direct your destruction toward the things you need to complete it.

pages.title: Mahjong Masters
pages.creator: PT Arena Solusi Digital
pages.description: Race an opponent to find matching pairs in Mahjong Masters. Each round lasts two minutes, so look for available pairs and keep clearing tiles while the clock runs. Win rounds to collect battle points and move up the standings against a succession of new opponents.

pages.title: Find The Missing Part
pages.creator: BestGameSpot
pages.description: Examine an incomplete picture in Find The Missing Part and choose the missing sections from fifteen possible pieces. Compare the details and outlines before making your selection, but keep an eye on the short time limit. Work through one hundred puzzles as the images become harder to complete.

pages.title: Party Games Mini Shooter Battle
pages.creator: CarGames.Com
pages.description: Move and fire through cartoon firefights in Party Games Mini Shooter Battle. Your character automatically aims toward the nearest target, leaving you to dodge incoming bullets and pick when to shoot. Try the four modes and spend coins and gems on additional characters and guns.

pages.title: Volley Beans - Volleyball Game
pages.creator: Tummy Games DOO
pages.description: Jump to meet the ball in Volley Beans - Volleyball Game and send it over the net. Time your taps for a bounce or a smash, then be ready for the return. The small court makes the timing of each jump important as you try to get the ball past your opponent.

pages.title: Cannon Merge
pages.creator: GamePush
pages.description: Defend your base from snow monsters in Cannon Merge. Combine identical cannons to produce stronger guns, then use coins from defeated enemies to buy more. Balance spending on weapons with improvements to the base so your defenses can hold against the growing attacks.

pages.title: Frogga
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Hop across busy roads in Frogga. Wait for a safe gap before moving into the next lane, since cars become faster and obstacles trickier as you advance. Collect bonuses and power-ups when you can reach them without putting the frog in the path of traffic.

pages.title: Black Friday Stacker
pages.creator: Azerion Casual Games
pages.description: Stack boxed electronics without tipping the pile in Black Friday Stacker. Drag products into place and think about their size and balance before letting go. Work through forty levels, using the objects already on the stack to support the next item without bringing everything down.

pages.title: Draw 2 Save Doge
pages.creator: YAD.Com
pages.description: Draw a barrier to protect the puppy from bees in Draw 2 Save Doge. The shield must keep the dog safe for ten seconds, so consider where the bees can get around it. Use less ink when you can to improve the star rating for your solution.

pages.title: Crossword Island
pages.creator: Ringier Axel Springer Polska
pages.description: Solve word puzzles while exploring a virtual archipelago in Crossword Island. Fill the answers into the crossword and collect rewards from completed boards. Use your progress to open more levels and visit new island locations, with a fresh set of words to work out at each stop.

pages.title: Idle Island Build And Survive
pages.creator: YAD.Com
pages.description: Start life on a deserted island in Idle Island Build And Survive. Gather resources, mine materials and make tools before building a place to live. Explore to find what you need for food and shelter, and choose which parts of your small settlement to develop first.

pages.title: INVERSION 2048
pages.creator: Realinspirer
pages.description: Merge numbers in INVERSION 2048 while keeping track of the world's two states. When the world flips, the blocks change to their secondary numbers, creating a different set of possible merges. Spend earned points in the in-game shop and see what the inversion lets you combine next.

pages.title: Bubble Shooter Challenge
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description: Shoot bubbles into groups of at least three matching colors in Bubble Shooter Challenge. Clear space quickly as new bubbles appear and keep the cluster from reaching the bottom of the screen. Think about where each shot will land so the next color still has somewhere useful to go.

pages.title: My Perfect Christmas Costumes
pages.creator: Cutedressup
pages.description: Dress Ellie and her friends for a holiday celebration in My Perfect Christmas Costumes. Browse each wardrobe for a festive outfit, then add accessories that work with the clothes. Try different makeover choices to give each friend her own look for Christmas.

pages.title: Christmas Bridge Runner
pages.creator: YAD.Com
pages.description: Gather stockings of your own color in Christmas Bridge Runner and use them to build a bridge. Choose a crossing, lay down the collected stockings and head for the finish before the other runners complete theirs. Keep collecting when your supply is too small to cover the gap.

pages.title: Super scissors
pages.creator: happyGames
pages.description: Guide a character forward with a pair of scissors in Super scissors. Cut the hair along the route and steer around the obstacles that interrupt your progress. Work through each stretch of the cartoon course until you can reach the finish.

pages.title: Blocks Chain Deluxe
pages.creator: Lof Games
pages.description: Trace a route that covers every square in Blocks Chain Deluxe. Begin at the tile marked S and work through the maze without leaving any blocks uncolored. Look ahead at branches and dead ends before committing to a direction, and restart when your route leaves an unreachable area.

pages.title: Crazy Egg Catch Endless
pages.creator: BestGameSpot
pages.description: Send eggs to the correct conveyor in Crazy Egg Catch Endless. Watch the color of each egg and switch the portal to match before it arrives. Keep the routing accurate so eggs reach their belts instead of being wasted and upsetting the chicken.

pages.title: Candy Tile Blast
pages.creator: BestGamesFreePlay.com
pages.description: Tap groups of at least two identical candies in Candy Tile Blast. Focus on the colors and quantities requested by the level, then use the gaps left by one blast to find another. Collect all the required tiles to finish the board.

pages.title: My Home Design Dreams
pages.creator: gamesmunch.com
pages.description: Create an interior for your own house in My Home Design Dreams. Explore decorating choices and select the furniture and finishes that suit each space. Meet the characters in the story as you turn rooms into a home with a style of your own.

pages.title: Bubble Shooter Level Pack
pages.creator: Lof Games
pages.description: Choose one of three available bubbles and fire it into the cluster in Bubble Shooter Level Pack. Match colors to remove every bubble from the screen across forty-eight stages. Switch to a different shot when it gives you a better match than the bubble currently selected.

pages.title: Heroes Inc!
pages.creator: YAD.Com
pages.description: Combine materials to create fighters in Heroes Inc! Test the heroes you produce against unusual enemies and watch how their abilities work in combat. Keep experimenting with the available combinations as you manufacture a team for the fights ahead.

pages.title: Valentine Mahjong
pages.creator: Wanted 5 Games B.V.
pages.description: Link matching romantic tiles in Valentine Mahjong and clear them from the table. Look for pairs with an open connecting route, then use the spaces they leave to reach tiles deeper in the layout. Continue until no tiles remain.

pages.title: Thor King Pig
pages.creator: FBK
pages.description: Guide Thor across platforms to the exit in Thor King Pig. Use the double jump to reach higher ground and watch for enemies along the route. Explore carefully enough to find a path through the stage while keeping the door as your main destination.

pages.title: Hero 2 Super Kick
pages.creator: GoGoMan
pages.description: Smash enemies as a giant mutant in Hero 2 Super Kick. Use different attacks to scatter the opposition and leap between buildings to reach snipers on the roofs. Explore the streets and rooftops as you search for the enemies still standing.

pages.title: Zombies Shooter Part 1
pages.creator: GoGoMan
pages.description: Fight your way through an infected city in Zombies Shooter Part 1. Check the streets and houses for zombies and use the weapons available to clear them out. Watch the ground after a hit, since enemies with injured legs can still crawl toward you.

pages.title: Ragdoll Duel 2P
pages.creator: RHM Interactive
pages.description: Time the swaying gun's shots in Ragdoll Duel 2P to hit the other fighter. Play against a friend or take on the single-player mode, where earned coins can improve health and weapon power. Read the ragdoll's movement before firing so each shot has a useful angle.

pages.title: Car vs Missile
pages.creator: Renan Games
pages.description: Drive through the city while homing missiles chase your car in Car vs Missile. Choose streets that give you room to change direction, pick up defensive power-ups and collect coins. Spend the earnings on new cars and upgrades to help on later escapes.

pages.title: Tunnel Runner
pages.creator: Drmop Games
pages.description: Race through tunnels and along pipes in Tunnel Runner, steering away from anything blocking the route. The courses become harder as you progress through a large set of layouts. Look for shields that give you some protection when a narrow passage catches you off guard.

pages.title: Fish Rescue! Pin Pull
pages.creator: Gamealliz
pages.description: Pull pins to bring a fish to safety in Fish Rescue! Pin Pull. Study how the barriers separate the fish from predators before removing one. Choose an order that opens a safe route while keeping dangerous creatures away from the fish you need to protect.

pages.title: What do animals eat
pages.creator: nau.games
pages.description: Match animals with their food in What do animals eat. Look at the creature shown and choose the meal it eats from the options. Work through the pictures to practice recognizing familiar animals and the different kinds of food they need.

pages.title: Genie Quest
pages.creator: Narenjo
pages.description: Connect at least three matching genies in Genie Quest to collect them from the board. Focus on the colors requested by each stage and use longer combinations to help with tougher arrangements. Work through the palace puzzles before your available moves run out.

pages.title: Donutosaur 2
pages.creator: bestphysics
pages.description: Help a candy-loving creature reach its treat in Donutosaur 2. Use the objects in each physics puzzle to move the monster, the candy or both until they meet. Plan a route that also picks up the stars when you want to fully complete a level.

pages.title: Join Blocks
pages.creator: tegagame.com
pages.description: Combine matching numbered tiles in Join Blocks to make higher values. Choose where to send the next block and look for a position that lets it meet an equal number. Keep the arrangement open enough to carry on building larger tiles.

pages.title: Classic Klondike Solitaire Card Game
pages.creator: LDGEngineering
pages.description: Sort the deck into four ascending suit piles in Classic Klondike Solitaire Card Game. Move cards around the tableau to free hidden ones, then build from ace to king on the foundations. Keep checking for newly available plays as you work toward clearing all fifty-two cards.

pages.title: Hiking Mahjong
pages.creator: Lof Games
pages.description: Remove matching outdoor-themed tiles in Hiking Mahjong. Check which pairs are available and use each cleared space to open another part of the board. If no useful move is visible, try a hint or shuffle and continue toward clearing the entire layout.

pages.title: Last Tank Attack
pages.creator: Yup7.com
pages.description: Take command of a tank in Last Tank Attack and destroy the opposing vehicles you encounter. Move around the battlefield to line up shots and avoid being overwhelmed. Collect aid packages on the ground to recover strength and keep the fight going.

pages.title: Driving Service Passenger Bus Transport
pages.creator: BestCrazyGames.com
pages.description: Drive passengers between stops in Driving Service Passenger Bus Transport. Pick people up at stations or in different towns, then guide the bus to their destination. Get used to the size of the vehicle as you handle each trip.

pages.title: Easter Match 3
pages.creator: Lof Games
pages.description: Swap adjacent Easter eggs in Easter Match 3 to make rows or columns of three matching colors. Use the matches to brighten every tile on the board. Check which squares still need work and direct your next swaps toward them to finish the level.

pages.title: Pixie Accident ER
pages.creator: SisiGames
pages.description: Treat an injured fairy in Pixie Accident ER after she flies into a tree. Follow the hospital prompts and choose the appropriate tools for each part of her treatment. Use the laser to remove germs and work through the injuries before sending Pixie back to the forest.

pages.title: Colors Swap
pages.creator: MBG Network
pages.description: Jump upward through colored obstacles in Colors Swap. Wait until the opening matches your ball's current color before passing through, and watch for changes as you climb. A wrong-color collision breaks the ball and ends the attempt.

pages.title: Hummer Trucks Jigsaw
pages.creator: newgamess
pages.description: Put together pictures of off-road vehicles in Hummer Trucks Jigsaw. Choose among twelve truck images and select an easy, medium or hard layout. Use details in the bodywork and background to find where the scattered pieces belong.

pages.title: Real Tractor Farmer
pages.creator: Instant Games Studio
pages.description: Take a tractor out onto the farm in Real Tractor Farmer. Drive and park the machine as you work through the jobs, getting used to its size and turning space. Follow the tasks to see how the farm's machinery is used.

pages.title: Hockey Challenge 3D
pages.creator: FG Studio
pages.description: Line up tricky shots on goal in Hockey Challenge 3D. Choose the direction with the mouse or touch controls, then see how the puck travels toward the target. Adjust your next attempt to account for the objects between you and the net.

pages.title: Armour Clash
pages.creator: GameOnHai
pages.description: Deploy tanks to destroy the opposing base in Armour Clash. Compare each unit's strengths and weaknesses before spending on the next deployment. Time your choices around the enemy force already on the field so your attack can reach the base.

pages.title: Stack Jump
pages.creator: Best Kids Games
pages.description: Jump onto moving blocks and build a tall tower in Stack Jump. Wait until a block is in a position you can land on, then time your leap for the next layer. Try to improve your endless-mode score or tackle the six increasingly difficult levels.

pages.title: Gas Station : Car Parking
pages.creator: FG Studio
pages.description: Drive around a service station in Gas Station : Car Parking. Guide cars into the workshop and parking areas as you work through the station's tasks. Pay attention to the space available around each vehicle while moving through the car-care setting.

pages.title: Adam and Eve 7
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description: Guide Adam through another set of prehistoric predicaments in Adam and Eve 7. Inspect the objects and creatures in each scene to find what can open the way forward. Solve the puzzles while watching for dinosaurs and other dangers along his journey.

pages.title: Warlings
pages.creator: Parrot Games
pages.description: Lead a team against the opposition in Warlings. Use the mouse to direct your attacks and work through the enemy fighters until none remain. Keep track of both teams as you decide how to handle the next exchange.

pages.title: Crazy Planet Match 3
pages.creator: Shunda Inc
pages.description: Line up matching planet faces in Crazy Planet Match 3. Make groups of three or more to score and keep the meter from falling too low. Watch the pieces that appear after each match so you can choose another move before the game ends.

pages.title: Extreme Car Driving Simulator Game
pages.creator: gamesfog
pages.description: Take on nine driving assignments in Extreme Car Driving Simulator Game. Chase vehicles, escort VIPs and collect checkpoints as you work through the mission list. Unlock faster cars and learn how each one handles before pushing it through the next objective.

pages.title: Cute Anime Princess Dress Up
pages.creator: 8Games.Net
pages.description: Dress six anime-style princesses in Cute Anime Princess Dress Up. Choose hairstyles, dresses, separates and accessories from a large wardrobe, then set the finished look against one of four backgrounds. Mix pieces freely to give each princess a different style.

pages.title: Magical Christmas Match 3
pages.creator: Shunda Inc
pages.description: Make rows of three or more matching holiday items in Magical Christmas Match 3. Keep producing matches so the meter on the left does not drop too far. Watch the new pieces that fall into place and use them to extend your score.

pages.title: Santa Claus Jigsaw
pages.creator: New Kids Games
pages.description: Assemble twelve festive pictures in Santa Claus Jigsaw, unlocking the next image after completing the current one. Choose a 25-, 49- or 100-piece layout for each puzzle and match the edges and colors to rebuild the scene.

pages.title: BTS Deer Coloring Book
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Choose a deer drawing in BTS Deer Coloring Book and fill it with colors. Pick shades for the animal and the surrounding details, then experiment with another combination when you want a different look. Work through the pictures at your own pace.

pages.title: Super 8 race
pages.creator: Bnagames
pages.description: Drive a Bugatti around four tracks in Super 8 race. Use the arrow keys or touch controls to steer through each course and challenge the other racers. Learn how the car takes the bends as you try to win every event.

pages.title: Elite SWAT Commander
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Enter a warehouse alone in Elite SWAT Commander and rescue the hostages. Your teammates are down, leaving you to pick out hostile targets with a pistol. Check each location carefully before shooting so you can clear the enemies without putting the captives at risk.

pages.title: Summer Match3
pages.creator: FG Studio
pages.description: Swap candies into groups of three or more in Summer Match3. Look across the board for a useful move, then check the arrangement left after a group disappears. Keep matching the summer-themed pieces to build your score.

pages.title: Crazy Pixel Warfare
pages.creator: BestCrazyGames
pages.description: Battle other players in a block-built arena in Crazy Pixel Warfare. Pick from weapons such as shotguns, rifles, axes and rocket launchers and use the layout to find a firing position. Switch weapons when the range of a fight changes.

pages.title: Gem Match Deluxe
pages.creator: Lof Games
pages.description: Swap gems to complete level goals in Gem Match Deluxe. Make a row or column of at least three identical jewels to remove them, then look for the matches left behind. Use power-ups when they help clear the pieces you still need.

pages.title: Sweet Pony Coloring Book
pages.creator: Hexa Games
pages.description: Choose from five pony drawings in Sweet Pony Coloring Book and fill them in with your own colors. Work on the large areas and smaller details until the picture looks the way you want. Save the finished page with the image button to share it afterward.

pages.title: Happy Slushie
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Draw paths to help a drink reach its cup in Happy Slushie. Route the liquid around obstacles and fill the container to finish each puzzle. Work through scenes with juice, ice cream and flavored ice, and try to earn three stars on every layout.

pages.title: Fruit Juice
pages.creator: FG Studio
pages.description: Slice fruit to prepare a drink in Fruit Juice. Watch the moving pieces and time the knife so it reaches the fruit instead of passing through empty space. Keep following the action as more fruit comes into range.

pages.title: Gun Master
pages.creator: LoraStudio
pages.description: Take aim at the enemies in Gun Master and tap to fire when your shot is lined up. Work through the targets and try the guns you obtain along the way. Pay attention to the direction of the weapon before shooting.

pages.title: BFF Medieval Fashion
pages.creator: MGS
pages.description: Dress Emma, Bonnie and Elena in historical-inspired outfits in BFF Medieval Fashion. Browse the clothes and accessories for each friend, then choose combinations that suit their competing looks. Compare the finished outfits to decide which medieval style you like most.

pages.title: Speed Starship
pages.creator: Webgameapp
pages.description: Pilot a ship through an obstacle-filled course in Speed Starship. Move away from the hazards as they approach and look for a clear passage ahead. Use the mouse to guide the ship and try to make it farther on each attempt.

pages.title: Puppy Blast
pages.creator: Yizhiyuan Network Technology Co., Ltd.
pages.description: Tap groups of at least two blocks in Puppy Blast to remove them from the board. Groups of five or more create special blocks, giving you another way to reach the level goals. Plan the use of these power-ups before your limited moves run out.

pages.title: Gold Miner Online
pages.creator: EcapsGames.com
pages.description: Lower the miner's grabber to collect gold and jewels in Gold Miner Online. Line it up with a valuable piece and watch for gunpowder barrels mixed into the digging area. Gather the required treasure without pulling in something that can spoil the attempt.

pages.title: Commando
pages.creator: pogames.in
pages.description: Carry out five missions in Commando, a third-person military shooter. Enter hostile areas, search for time bombs and use them against targets such as camps or vehicles. Move around cover and choose when to reveal your position as you work through each assignment.

pages.title: Slendrina Must Die: The Forest
pages.creator: danygames.com
pages.description: Search for seven keys in Slendrina Must Die: The Forest to uncover the secret hidden there. Watch for Slendrina and her family as they guard the area. Find and use the available firearms while exploring the forest for the remaining keys.

pages.title: Sweet Babies Jigsaw
pages.creator: New Kids Games
pages.description: Rebuild twelve baby pictures in Sweet Babies Jigsaw. Complete the first puzzle to unlock the next image, then keep working through the set. Choose an easy 25-piece board or raise the difficulty to 49 or 100 pieces when you want more to sort.

pages.title: Line Puzzle Artist
pages.creator: Yizhiyuan Network Technology Co., Ltd.
pages.description: Drag the lines into a new arrangement in Line Puzzle Artist. Study the reference image and move the connected segments until they make the same shape. Compare the corners and angles when your result is close but still does not match.

pages.title: Jewelry Competition
pages.creator: KidsGames4All
pages.description: Change the positions of the jewels in Jewelry Competition to meet the incoming pieces. Watch the order they arrive in and use left or right mouse clicks to bring identical jewels together. Keep adjusting the lower arrangement as the next set comes down.

pages.title: Cannon Ball
pages.creator: Freak X Games
pages.description: Launch a cannonball at a fort in Cannon Ball. Drag to set the angle of the shot, knock off the guards' hats and collect stars to complete the stage. Look at how the structure supports itself before choosing where to send the ball.

pages.title: Balloon Hero 2
pages.creator: igroutka.ru
pages.description: Help a balloon-lifted hero float upward in Balloon Hero 2. Click the character to climb, but watch the obstacles that can damage the balloons. Choose your moments to rise so the hero keeps enough lift to make it through the route.

pages.title: Merge Car
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Combine matching vehicles to improve your collection in Merge Car. Work through quests as you develop the cars, and try the lucky wheel for another part of the progression. Keep arranging the collection so there is room to make the next upgrade.

pages.title: Bubble Shooter Pet
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Pop colored bubbles and work through the stages in Bubble Shooter Pet. Aim at matching groups and use special bubbles when they help clear the board. Try for a three-star result in level mode or switch to endless play for a longer run.

pages.title: Crazy Dots
pages.creator: T
pages.description: Switch a dot's color to meet the incoming pieces in Crazy Dots. Watch what color is approaching before making the change, then prepare for the next one. Keep the sequence going as the action speeds up and try to improve your record.

pages.title: Bicycle Simulator
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Ride a bike around the city in Bicycle Simulator. Explore the streets and try jumps, tricks and stunts wherever the surroundings give you room. Practice the controls to see how the bike responds before attempting a bigger maneuver.

pages.title: Bonnie Oktoberfest
pages.creator: Unify Media Inc.
pages.description: Help Bonnie get ready to visit Munich in Bonnie Oktoberfest. Choose a look for the autumn festival and coordinate the pieces she will wear for the celebration. Try the available styling choices to finish her outfit before she goes.

pages.title: Yellow Ball Adventure
pages.creator: QkyGames
pages.description: Roll and bounce through eighteen stages in Yellow Ball Adventure. Time jumps to clear traps and use the platforms to reach the next part of the route. Watch where the ball will land as you make your way to each level's end.

pages.title: Rolling Cheese
pages.creator: Code This Lab srl
pages.description: Break supports to deliver cheese to a hungry mouse in Rolling Cheese. Work out how the cheese will roll before removing an object, then let gravity carry it toward the mouse. Pick up as many of the three strawberries as possible for extra points.

pages.title: Coloring Underwater World 2
pages.creator: Age Simple Games
pages.description: Color fish and jellyfish in Coloring Underwater World 2. Use free mode to choose any palette you like, or try challenge mode to remember and reproduce the colors shown in the hint. Aim for five stars when you can match the reference accurately.

pages.title: Pony Fly in a Fantasy World
pages.creator: Playtouch
pages.description: Keep a little pony airborne in Pony Fly in a Fantasy World. Each tap gives it a lift, so judge the gaps in the approaching walls and adjust your height before reaching them. Stay clear of the surfaces to keep flying.

pages.title: Madmen Racing
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description: Race unusual bikes and cars against other drivers in Madmen Racing. Win challenges to move forward and upgrade the vehicles you use. Get familiar with the way each ride handles as you take it over the bumps and jumps of the 2D courses.

pages.title: Mr & Mrs Easter Wedding
pages.creator: MGS
pages.description: Decorate eggs as a bride and groom in Mr & Mrs Easter Wedding. Help the Frozen couples choose wedding looks for their Easter characters and prepare a hall for the ceremony. Bring the outfits and decorations together to finish the celebration.

pages.title: Untamed
pages.creator: littlegiantworld
pages.description: Defend against advancing enemies in Untamed. Fire at the attackers, use your shield when you need protection and improve your equipment between battles. Experiment with the available skills and summoned allies as you work through the stages and face stronger opposition.

pages.title: Klondike solitaire
pages.creator: Julio Cesar Fuente Saugar
pages.description: Build foundation piles by suit in Klondike solitaire while sorting the tableau into playable sequences. Choose draw-one or draw-three rules for turning cards from the stock. Reveal hidden cards and look for plays that free another move as you work through the deck.

pages.title: Saira's Boutique
pages.creator: Csharks Games & Solutions Pvt Ltd.
pages.description: Help a new designer finish orders in Saira's Boutique. Add embroidery and painted details to dresses for women and children, working through the choices for each garment. Use the available designs to give the boutique's clothes a finished look.

pages.title: Battle Pet
pages.creator: Onduck Games
pages.description: Move boxes toward the center of the field in Battle Pet. Each fighter controls an Ink creature in a contest between Marin's team and five rivals. Choose boxes carefully as you try to complete the route before your opponent can take advantage of your moves.

pages.title: Real Love Tester
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description: Enter two names in Real Love Tester and press the test button to reveal the game's compatibility result. Try another pairing to compare the displayed matches, or experiment with the names of fictional couples.

pages.title: Neutrino
pages.creator: Piponga
pages.description: Rotate the trap in Neutrino to sort the incoming particles. Catch neutrinos while destroying antineutrinos, watching what is approaching before turning the mechanism. Time each adjustment so the next particle meets the appropriate part of the trap.

pages.title: Ice Queen Wardrobe Cosplay
pages.creator: SisiGames
pages.description: Sort the Ice Queen's clothes before trying costumes in Ice Queen Wardrobe Cosplay. Collect scattered pieces, put them in the closet and see which character outfits you have recovered. Match them with accessories or combine pieces to make a costume of your own.

pages.title: Rick and Morty
pages.creator: Unify Media Inc.
pages.description: Get Rick and Morty ready for an interdimensional trip in Rick and Morty. Begin with Rick's test, then work through the preparations the characters need before leaving. Try the available choices to see how the pair look once they are ready.

pages.title: Music Board
pages.creator: Dob5 Games
pages.description: Follow the sequence of notes in Music Board and play it back with the correct rhythm. Watch which notes come next and time your responses to keep the tune going. Complete the sequence to hear the piece come together.

pages.title: Im the one
pages.creator: Cosmity
pages.description: Guide the red car in the first lane to the finish in Im the one. Time its movement around bullets fired from the walls so it survives the trip. Reach the goal to add another win and check the stored count by tapping it.

pages.title: Tank Fury
pages.creator: Red Eye Production
pages.description: Fight other armored vehicles in Tank Fury. Move your tank into firing position, shoot the opposing machines and keep track of your remaining health during the exchange. Try the available tank models and work toward stronger versions as you continue battling.

pages.title: Princess Coachella Inspired Wedding
pages.creator: MyCuteGames
pages.description: Prepare Ariel and her bridesmaids for a festival-themed ceremony in Princess Coachella Inspired Wedding. Dress Anna and Moana alongside the bride and coordinate their clothes and accessories. Give the group looks that fit Ariel and Eric's chosen wedding theme.

pages.title: Titanic Museum
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description: Search exhibits about the famous shipwreck in Titanic Museum. Look over each display and click the hidden objects you are asked to find. Scan the smaller details when only a few remain, then continue through the museum's other scenes.

pages.title: Mermaid Melody
pages.creator: Casual_Azerion_Old
pages.description: Choose outfits for a group of sirens in Mermaid Melody. Try the available clothing and accessories on each character and bring the pieces together into a finished style. Experiment with different combinations to give the mermaids individual looks.
